name: Type 10 (TK-X)
armament: 120 mm L/44 smoothbore with bustle autoloader
protection: Modular nano-crystal steel/ceramic armour, add-on modules on turret. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW/NLAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: Compact low tank (44 t) with an angular welded turret and flat sloped modular armour panels
Five road wheels per side, hydropneumatic suspension (can kneel/tilt), side skirts
Commander's panoramic sight on turret roof, large rear turret bustle
Fitted with C4I antennas; JGSDF two-tone camouflage
